policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 09. Record eight confirmed science-target Persons as verify-only science_retained checkpoints while moving one clear humanities Person from legacy knowledge to culture. Every retained Person must remain live Production knowledge until final cutover; the culture correction requires live previous_domain=knowledge.

review_scope.selection_rule: Use a compact 9-Person unit to introduce durable science-retain checkpoints on eight unambiguous science/formal-inquiry figures sharing simple batch-008 provenance, plus one source-clear humanities correction for Jeong Yak-yong.

entries.basis: V2 culture includes philosophy, social thought, scholarship, and intellectual history. Jeong Yak-yong displayed scientific and technical interests, but his representative historical identity is the late-Joseon Silhak scholar, reform thinker, and prolific author who synthesized practical-learning thought across government, economy, society, culture, and philosophy.

science_retained.basis: V2 science explicitly includes mathematics and formal inquiry. Turing is represented by foundational work in mathematics, logic, computability, cryptanalysis, and theoretical computer science.
Lavoisier's representative identity is experimental chemistry and the quantitative transformation of chemical science; this is an unambiguous v2 science retain.
Rutherford is represented by experimental research on radioactivity and atomic structure and by foundational work in nuclear physics; the v2 target is science.
Mendel's representative identity is empirical heredity research and the foundational experimental work later recognized as genetics; the v2 target is science.
Maxwell is represented as a physicist and mathematician whose electromagnetic theory unified electricity, magnetism, and light; the v2 target is science.
Planck is represented by theoretical physics and the introduction of energy quanta, a foundational contribution to quantum theory; the v2 target is science.
Faraday's representative identity is experimental physics and chemistry, especially electromagnetism and electrochemistry; the v2 target is science.
Kepler is represented by mathematical astronomy and the laws of planetary motion; the v2 target is science.
